hits.snippet: Richter to lead the company into its next chapter of growth and continued success._ RALEIGH, NC, UNITED STATES, August 10, 2026 / [EINPresswire.com](https://www.einpresswire.com/) / -- BE&K Building Group (BE&K), a leading design-build and construction management services company with more than 55 years of national experience delivering complex, high-performance projects, has [announced](https://bekbg.com/david-l-richter-named-chief-executive-officer-at-bek-building-group/) that David L. Richter, PE, PMP, CCQM, has been appointed Chief Executive Officer, effective immediately. Frank Holley, who has served as the company's CEO since 2019, has transitioned to the role of Chairman as part of a planned leadership succession. Nidal Zayed, Chairman, President, and CEO of Pernix Group (BE&K's parent company), remarked that this transition honors the company's growth under Frank's leadership and sets the stage for its next chapter under David. "Under Frank's guidance, BE&K has achieved significant growth in recent years.
